newsitem.title: USA: Fresh technology slide deepens recent Nasdaq woes.
newsitem.headline: Fresh technology slide deepens recent Nasdaq woes.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks closed lower on Wednesday, the eighth loss in the last nine sessions, amid heavy selling in technology shares.
The Nasdaq Composite Index slipped 20.05 points, or 1.58 percent to an unofficial close of 1249.29.
"A lot of people consider this a market top and now we're seeing a blow-off," said one trader.
Traders continued to cite fears of higher interest rates for technology stock weakness.
Federal Reserve policymakers are expected to raise rates shortly, possibly as soon as their meeting next Tuesday.
Intel fell 3-1/8 to 133-5/8 and Microsoft lost 2-7/8 to 96-3/4.
Adobe Systems led a short list of winners, rising 4-1/8 to 39 on surprisingly strong first quarter profits.
Leading the most actives was Cisco Systems, which slipped 3/8 to 50 along with other networking stocks. The second most active share, Ascend Communications 2-3/8 to 45-3/4.
Declining issues led advancing shares 2,975 to 1,400, with 221 new lows and 56 new highs posted.
Total trading volume was 703 million shares.
